text:
jon: Quick sync 7 BetaCorp POC: they want ephemeral +50% burst headroom for demo week, prefer a hard cap to avoid surprises, and need private endpoint connectivity. Also asked for scoped API tokens for each demo operator and a per-token rate limit. Any red flags?
maya: Which pool? baseline? sequence lengths? KMS?
maria: Pool is dp-beta-21 (baseline 24 GPUs). Mostly long seqs (1k-3k tokens) but relatively low concurrency (~3 sessions). KMS required. No reserved commit.
rachel: We can do +50% but recommend staggered ramp to avoid slow spin-up. Hard cap is doable but ops needs explicit signoff for auto-shutdown. Finance: caps above $2k need pre-approval.
jon: Customer ok with staggered ramp. Propose ramp: +20% first day, +35% next, +50% after that. Target demo hours 08:00-16:00 PT weekdays. Propose cap $6k for the week, alerts at $4k.
maya: Autoscale config sample:
```yaml
pool_id: dp-beta-21
baseline_gpus: 24
burst:
  enabled: true
  schedule: "08:00-16:00" # PT weekdays
  ramp_sequence: [20,35,50]
  hard_cap_cost: 6000
  alerts_at: 4000
priority:
  method: header
  header_name: "x-poc-flag"
  header_value: "betacorp-demo"
keying:
  token_prefix: "demo-beta-"
  per_token_rate_limit: "50r/s"
kms: true
```
infra-bot: Ticket TCK-9021 created for private endpoint + burst config. Assigned to @maya and @rachel. Estimated peering time 48-72h.
finance: Noted. Pre-approve $6k cap for the POC. Hard shutdown needs ops lead confirmation; otherwise we default to throttling at cap.
jon: Ok will confirm with customer whether they want auto-shutdown or throttling. If throttling, will accept.
maya: Let's ensure demo keys are short-lived and telemetry captured for cost attribution. I'll join the smoke test Mon 09:30 PT.
rachel: I'll validate network prerequisites. jon: Thanks team, I'll send customer the plan and link to the smoke test invite.
